solves.reasoning: (A) 화가가 vivid scenes로 알려짐→known, (B) vivid scenes에 어울리는 색→bright, (C) 걸작이 가져온 recognition→national. known—bright—national=①
(A) 할렘으로→moved, (B) 해안경비대에서→served, (C) 대학에서 16년간→taught. moved—served—taught=②
(A) 많은 그림을→produced, (B) 명예 학위를→received, (C) 탐구를→continued. produced—received—continued=③
④ 'but most of them were saved' — but 뒤라 부정적 결과(lost)여야 함. saved는 모순
② dull colors — vivid scenes 화가는 bright colors를 씀. dull은 반대
③ studied at University for 16 years — 명예 학위 받은 화가는 taught(가르쳤다)여야 함
걸작이 brought him national ___ → 긍정적 명성 recognition
bright ___ and simplified shapes → 화가가 쓰는 colors(색)
received honorary ___ from universities including Harvard → degrees(명예 학위)
vivid(생생한)=vibrant. dull/plain은 반대, silent는 무관
explore(탐구하다)=examine. ignore/avoid/forget은 반대 방향
produced(제작했다)=created. destroyed는 반대, sold/hid는 다른 뜻
simplified(단순화된)↔complicated(복잡한). plain은 유의어, bright는 다른 축
lost(분실된)↔found(되찾은). missing은 유의어, damaged/stolen은 다른 축
(A) moved to a new house=이사, (B) documentary moved everyone=감동. 이사—감동=①
'finest/greatest work an artist created'=masterpiece(걸작). sketch/portrait/gallery는 다름
produced many ___ (paint): many 뒤 복수명사 필요 → paintings
before his ___ (die): 소유격 his 뒤 명사 필요 → death
explore ___ through painting; 글 주제가 African-American → the lives of African-Americans
Later, he taught ___ + 다음 문장 명예 학위 → at the University of Washington for 16 years
